# KuniJiban borehole logs

Three borehole logs in the Japanese electronic-delivery XML format (地質・土質調査成果電子納品要領), downloaded on
2026-10-07 from 国土地盤情報検索サイト「KuniJiban」 (https://www.kunijiban.pwri.go.jp), by KuniJiban borehole ID:

| File | Format version | Survey (client: 国土交通省 関東地方整備局 横浜国道事務所) |
|---|---|---|
| `148301107.xml` | 2.10 | Ｈ１２横湘とりまとめ（その４－１）業務 |
| `357875393.xml` | 4.00 | R2圏央道地質調査業務 (高速横浜環状南線) |
| `509132859.xml` | 4.00 | 横環南栄IC・JCT下部（その20）工事 |

They are kept as downloaded, in their original Shift_JIS encoding, to test the importer on real files, except that personal data are removed: the names and registration numbers of the survey engineers (`…_氏名`, `…_登録番号`) and the contractor's telephone number are left empty.

Source: 国土地盤情報検索サイト「KuniJiban」の地盤情報 (ground information from the KuniJiban site, operated by MLIT,
PWRI and PARI). Under the KuniJiban terms of use, individual borehole logs carry no copyright and may be copied and
redistributed, provided they are identified as KuniJiban ground information. No copyright is claimed on them here,
and the repository's Apache-2.0 licence does not apply to them.
